title: BackendChangesError and BackendSetError missing From<Self::Error> impl — requires manual match at call sites
description: Every handler that calls get_changes/query_changes maps BackendChangesError::Other(inner) => JmapError::server_fail(inner.to_string()). This pattern is repeated 6+ times. With impl From<BackendChangesError<E>> for JmapError (or similar), the ? operator would eliminate the repeated map_err blocks. More importantly, the repeated manual match is where JMAP-isx.2 slipped in — a contributor copied the pattern and got the error type wrong. The adapter pattern would make the correct conversion the default path. Fix: implement From<BackendChangesError<E>> for JmapError where E: std::error::Error, and similarly for BackendSetError.
